prompt: Compare the IR of these two carbonyls — one is a normal ketone, the other is an α,β-unsaturated ketone. Which pair of C=O frequencies is correct?

options.label: Normal ketone ~1715; conjugated enone ~1680 (conjugation lowers C=O)

explanation: Conjugation of C=O with an adjacent C=C (or aryl ring) delocalizes the π bond → lowers bond order of the C=O slightly → lower stretching frequency. Normal ketone ~1715; α,β-unsaturated ~1680; aryl ketone ~1685. The same shift happens with ester (1735→1715 if conjugated).
